marta: Quick check — I'm planning to run a bulk-tagging job to add the tag `enablement_pending` to accounts created >=7 days ago with zero enablement_events. Want ops + data sanity check before I kick it off. cc @sunil @alex

sunil: Can you paste the exact query/filter? We need to avoid tagging trial->paid conversions or recently claimed accounts.

marta: Sure, here's the dry-run SQL I used:
```sql
SELECT a.account_id, a.created_at, ev.count as enablement_events, s.status as sub_status
FROM accounts a
LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, count(*) as count FROM enablement_events WHERE created_at > now() - interval '90 days' GROUP BY account_id) ev USING (account_id)
LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON s.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.created_at <= now() - interval '7 days'
  AND coalesce(ev.count, 0) = 0
  AND (s.status IS NULL OR s.status = 'trial')
LIMIT 100;
```

alex: Looks mostly OK but add an exclusion for subscriptions with converted_at >= now() - interval '30 days' (recent converts). Also we should snapshot healthscore before mutation so we can diff.

marta: Good call. I'll add the converted_at exclusion and write to cs_healthscore_snapshot_v2 before tagging. Example dry-run output (10 rows):
```
account_id | created_at  | enablement_events | sub_status | health_score
1234       | 2026-02-15  | 0                 | NULL       | 0.22
5678       | 2026-02-10  | 0                 | trial      | 0.18
```

emma: Use cs_healthscore_snapshot_v2 for snapshots and include owner_claimed boolean in the snapshot so we can route owners for enablement nudges. Also, set a safe list for accounts tagged as "no-contact".

marta: Updated query to exclude recent converts and no-contact list. Will run a dry-run first (write-only snapshot + simulate tagging). Sample job config:
```yaml
job_name: enablement-bulk-tagging-v2
dry_run: true
window: 1h
exclude_recent_converts_days: 30
snapshot_table: cs_healthscore_snapshot_v2
route_tag: enablement_pending
```

sunil: Proceed with dry-run. If more than 1% of accounts have health_score delta > 0.5 or owner_claimed flips unexpectedly, abort and escalate. We'll want a rollback playbook ready. :warning:
